name: Record history
description: Read the past of records of a model that keeps a history: who changed what, when, and what a record looked like then. What is shown follows the model's rules as they are today.

capabilities.name: Read the history of a record
capabilities.description: List the versions of a record and compare two of them (history::list, history::diff). Reading a record as it was (db::get with as_of) needs db::query.

capabilities.name: Put a record back
capabilities.description: Put a record back to an earlier version, or take back your own last change (history::restore, history::undo). The write is an ordinary update, so it also needs db::mutate and obeys the model's checks, workflow and the caller's rules.

capabilities.name: Redact history
capabilities.description: Blot out the values of fields in a record's whole history, for a legal erasure (history::redact). Administrators only; it cannot be undone.
